Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 14-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICMR NIHR Young Professional-II (Administration) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive applications for the ICMR NIHR Young Professional-II (Administration) recruitment is 14-10-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional-II (Administration) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Young Professional-II (Administration) post in the ICMR NIHR recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Post Graduates with at least 55% marks and possess 3 years of post-qualification experience in administration from a recognized research organization or institute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-II (Administration) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Young Professional-II (Administration) post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their applications to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Young Professional-II (Administration) post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, followed by a Personal Interview, and finally, a Final Merit List will be prepared.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the ICMR NIHR?
faq.answer: The ICMR NIHR is located in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, with the pincode 342005.
